verdict.rationale: Asking whether an email inbox also handles SMS, WhatsApp, social or live chat is a fair question for an inbox product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Outlook bringing any non-email customer channel into the inbox. The documentation covers only mail, inbox rules, notes, categories and change notifications.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
